## Quarto

Here, I am determining the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain, in humans, pigs and mice. 

Humans:
```{r}
sum(180,162,83,57,110,87,67,22,37,196,90,45,45)
```

Pigs:
```{r}
sum(109,165,89,157,31,45,114,4,49,41,37,121,236)
```

Mice:
```{r}
sum(55,182,158,185,60,98,47,62,38,98,98,91)
```

Pigs have the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression, with 1198 genes.
